*** Add File: /private/tmp/donor-name-design-20261008/a/design.md
+# Typed evidence inside the existing component policy
+
+## Problem
+
+The scorer already emits exact-name candidates, including genuine scores for repeated profiles. `identity.rs` currently expands those profiles, seeds company-number components, and applies one name/address/threshold rule. Extend that policy without changing scoring or attribution. Exact usable donor names may join across absent or disagreeing addresses, while explicit kinds and competing companies still prevent unsafe unions. The current `ids.len() > 1 => StatisticalLink` outcome rule must disappear.
+
+## Usage (caller's view)
+
+The CLI and `ResolutionInput` workflow stay unchanged. The three observable cases are:
+
+```rust
+// Within the existing resolve implementation.
+let mut edges = expanded_edges(input, scoring, scored_pairs)?;
+let mut components = Components::new(input);
+components.apply(input, &mut edges);
+let observations = components.outcomes(input, &edges, run_key);
+```
+
+```text
+Donor A: Gary Lubner, no address
+Donor B: Gary Lubner, another/no address
+=> same run-local identity, donor_name_link;
+   pair accepted with exact_donor_name, original probability retained.
+```
+
+```text
+A --statistical--> B --donor name--> C
+=> same identity, statistical_and_donor_name_link on all three;
+   pair reasons retain the distinct evidence for each accepted edge.
+
+Company X <--eligible-- unanchored A --eligible--> unanchored B --eligible--> Company Y
+=> A and B may join each other, but neither attaches to X or Y;
+   both anchor attachment candidates remain review/competing_company_anchors.
+```
+
+`identity_basis` describes the evidence required by the resulting component. `SourceReportedCompany` remains an explicit per-observation override when the observation itself supplies an accepted company number. This definition avoids implying that a statistical subcluster alone proves membership in the larger name-linked identity.
+
+## Shape
+
+Keep the private policy in `identity.rs`; add output enum variants in `declaration_resolution.rs`. No new service, public method, scorer representation, or module. The existing checked `Observation` boundary already excludes empty normalized names and donor metadata on other roles.
+
+```rust
+#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
+enum LinkEvidence {
+    Statistical,
+    DonorName,
+}
+
+enum EdgeEligibility {
+    Link(LinkEvidence),
+    Review,
+    Reject(PairReason),
+}
+
+// Stored next to the unchanged scored decision while resolving.
+struct CandidateEdge {
+    decision: PairDecision,
+    eligibility: EdgeEligibility,
+}
+type CandidateEdges = BTreeMap<(FunderObservationId, FunderObservationId), CandidateEdge>;
+
+fn classify(a: &Observation, b: &Observation, probability: f64) -> EdgeEligibility {
+    unimplemented!()
+}
+
+impl Components {
+    // Owns ambiguity analysis, constrained unions, and final pair dispositions.
+    fn apply(&mut self, input: &ResolutionInput, edges: &mut CandidateEdges) {
+        unimplemented!()
+    }
+
+    // Derives support from final accepted edges; no mutable provenance flags.
+    fn outcomes(
+        &self,
+        input: &ResolutionInput,
+        edges: &CandidateEdges,
+        run_key: &str,
+    ) -> Vec<ObservationResolution> {
+        unimplemented!()
+    }
+}
+
+// Extend existing exported output enums, preserving existing spellings.
+// PairReason::ExactDonorName
+// IdentityBasis::DonorNameLink
+// IdentityBasis::StatisticalAndDonorNameLink
+```
+
+Classification has one owner, per boundary-discipline. Check explicit person/organisation conflict first. Then prefer the existing statistical evidence when exact name, numbered-street address and threshold agree. Otherwise accept `DonorName` only when both roles are `Donor` and their present normalized names are equal. Apply full-address disagreement rejection only after this donor rule. Everything else remains review. The eligibility enum prevents the ambiguity pass and union pass from independently reimplementing what counts as a link. A donor-name edge never rewrites or thresholds the scorer's probability.
+
+Before any mutations, calculate competing company candidates over connected components of **unanchored observations** linked by eligible edges. Collect the distinct company numbers adjacent to each such component via eligible edges. More than one number freezes all attachments from that component to company anchors as review. Unanchored-to-unanchored edges remain eligible. This prevents pair order from assigning a name group to whichever company appears first. Exclude rejected explicit kind conflicts before collecting candidates. Use `BTreeMap`/`BTreeSet`, as existing code does. This deliberately conservative ambiguity rule may count alternative paths that a later whole-component kind check would reject; conservatism is safer than selecting an arbitrary company.
+
+Apply the remaining eligible edges in stable ID order. Preserve the existing whole-component check for multiple company numbers and simultaneous explicit person/organisation kinds on every union. Equal-number company seeding stays unchanged. Existing company/company exclusion stays unchanged because their identity comes from the anchor rather than the pair scorer. The component owner is the only writer of membership and dispositions, per separate-before-serializing-shared-state.
+
+For each final component, derive a statistical-only connectivity graph using accepted statistical edges and equal-number seed links. If that graph connects the whole component, its basis is `StatisticalLink`. Otherwise donor-name evidence is necessary: use `StatisticalAndDonorNameLink` when the component contains any accepted statistical edge, and `DonorNameLink` otherwise. Singletons and unresolved observations retain their existing meanings. Anchored source observations retain `SourceReportedCompany`; all other observations receive the component basis. This is a conservative component-level statement and never falsely calls a mixed identity statistical. Redundant name edges do not downgrade a component already connected entirely by statistical evidence. Derive this from accepted edges, not which edge happened to perform a union, per single-source-of-truth.
+
+The interface remains one resolution operation. Callers neither coordinate provenance nor execute company ambiguity checks. Dominant access patterns use the existing ordered edge map and component member sets; two temporary graph traversals handle ambiguity and support. Candidate expansion keeps its current explicit budget and error behavior.
+
+## Synthesis decision
+
+Candidate A; the parent will record synthesis. This proposal integrates typed evidence with the existing scored-edge policy.
+
+## Tradeoffs accepted
+
+- We accept same-name false positives in exchange for the user's requested grouping, limited to donor-to-donor edges.
+- We accept conservative company abstention for connected unanchored candidate groups in exchange for deterministic anchor selection.
+- We accept a component-level mixed basis in exchange for a small output contract. Pair reasons provide the specific evidence for individual links.
+
+## Alternatives considered
+
+An independent donor-name preclustering stage could collapse exact-name groups before statistical linking. It hides name grouping but makes callers or a second orchestration layer reconcile name clusters, anchor ambiguity, provenance, and pair outputs. It also invites fabricated scores for synthetic pairs or duplicate implementations of component constraints. The integrated design hides these decisions inside the current component owner and retains the existing real scored candidates.
+
+Per-observation paths to a canonical representative could label each membership statistical or name-based. That exposes representative selection as an evidentiary decision, and labels can change after harmless ID renaming. Component-level support plus pair reasons gives a stable, honest account with fewer rules.
+
+## Implementation reconciliation
+
+Design only. No implementation deviations accepted yet.
+
+## Open questions and risks
+
+Does the current scorer test explicitly prove that every exact-name block survives with low probabilities and missing addresses? Add that contract test if absent. No policy approval is needed: the brief already authorizes the weaker rule.
+
+## Next implementation step
+
+Add classification and component fixtures for missing/disagreeing donor addresses, mixed evidence, explicit kinds through unknown bridges, and indirect competing companies; then replace `strong` checks with typed eligibility, bump `POLICY_VERSION`, and update docs.
+
+Verification must retain original probabilities, leave attribution byte-for-byte equivalent for the fixture inputs, preserve other-role thresholds, and prove ID-order-independent company abstention. Run the existing Rust/Python/CLI checks and a real resolution run to verify Gary Lubner no longer remains 81 separate addressless identities. No company API calls or database schema changes are required.
*** End Patch"));

Created [design.md](/private/tmp/donor-name-design-20261008/a/design.md).

Proposes typed evidence within the existing component policy, deterministic ambiguity checks across unanchored candidate groups, and explicit mixed-component identity basis. Preserves real scores, company anchoring, role constraints, and independent attribution. Includes an alternative preclustering design and verification criteria. Source files remain unchanged.
